title: SurvivalIsland++
description: Survival Island focused modpack with Vanilla++ in mind.
body:
The modpack is meant to be played on a spawn/survival island map, a good seed for this might be `2055796538`.

Overhauls tons of vanilla features, adds new biomes where its necessary, more fishing, more food options.
## Prominent Mods:
- **Enchancement** - Enchanting is now more fun and less of a "god gear" grind.
- **Soft Worldborder** - Discourages running away from spawn island.
- **Beans Backpacks** - Simple backpacks.
- **Better Combat** - Makes pvp more interesting.
- **Exposure, Immersive Paintings, WATERFrAMES** - Adds custom items and blocks for players to enjoy.
- **Farmers Delight + Addons** - Adds a ton of new culinary items.
- **Fish of Thieves, Tide 2** - Adds tons of fishing related content.
- **Archery Expansion** - Makes bows have a progression similar to other tools.
- TONS more client side immersion mods that just make the base game more interesting.
